Risk Addressed: Users may retain inappropriate access after role changes or termination.
Primary Evidence: HR ticket; identity lifecycle log; access provisioning record

Control Description: Quarterly user access reviews are completed and approved by application owners.
Risk Addressed: Excessive or inappropriate access may remain undetected.

Risk Addressed: Administrative access may be misused or remain assigned without business need.

Control Description: Production changes require documented approval before implementation except approved emergency changes.
Risk Addressed: Unauthorized or untested changes may disrupt services or weaken controls.
Primary Evidence: Change ticket; approval history; deployment log

Control Description: Emergency changes are documented and retrospectively reviewed within one business day.
Risk Addressed: Emergency changes may bypass governance and remain unreviewed.

Control Description: Changes are tested in a non-production environment before production deployment when technically feasible.
Risk Addressed: Defects may be introduced into production without validation.
Primary Evidence: Test evidence; QA sign-off; change record

Control Description: Daily backups are scheduled and monitored for critical systems.
Risk Addressed: Loss of data or system recoverability may occur due to backup failure.

Control Description: Restore tests are performed for critical backups and results are documented.
Risk Addressed: Backups may exist but fail when restoration is required.

Control Description: Failed batch or scheduled jobs are monitored and investigated within defined SLA.
Risk Addressed: Processing failures may remain unresolved and affect business operations.
